name: Naphtali
summary: A son of Jacob, born to Bilhah, Rachel's maid. Jacob said Naphtali was a deer let loose who gives good words.

key_moments.title: Born to Bilhah
key_moments.description: Bilhah, Rachel's maid, bore Jacob a second son. Rachel named him Naphtali, saying she had wrestled with her sister with great wrestlings and had won.

key_moments.title: Goes Down to Egypt
key_moments.description: Naphtali went down to Egypt with his father Jacob and the whole family, along with his sons.

key_moments.title: Blessed by Jacob
key_moments.description: Jacob said Naphtali was a deer let loose who gives good words.
